title: Stray Kids’ ‘The dominATE Experience’ Concert Film Is Out on Blu-ray & It Includes a Bonus Performance
summary: The concert film follows the global K-pop stars onstage & backstage during their SoFi Stadium dates on their Dominate World Tour last year.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

It’s been a big summer for Stray Kids, who debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 with their latest album, THIS & THAT, which earned the K-pop group their ninth chart-topper to date. The boy band also topped the box-office charts back in February, when their concert film, Stray Kids: The dominATE Experience , hit No. 1 on its first day in theaters.

Now, fans can take the concert viewing experience home with a new deal that gets you Stray Kids: The dominATE Experience on Blu-ray and DVD for under $17 (less than the price of a movie ticket).

OFFICIAL BLU-RAY RELEASE

Stray Kids: The dominATE Experience [Blu-ray]

$16.99 $17.89 5% off

Buy Now On Amazon

Amazon has the Stray Kids live concert film available on Blu-ray for just $16.99 right now — a price drop from its original price of $18 and the lowest price in 90 days, per the retailer.

The concert film followed the global K-pop stars on stage and backstage during their sold-out SoFi Stadium dates on their Dominate World Tour last year. In addition to behind-the-scenes footage, the Blu-ray release features a bonus song that wasn’t shown in the theatrical release (spoiler alert: the song is “ITEM,” from the group’s 2023 studio album , 5-STAR ).

Moviegoers flocked to theaters to watch Stray Kids: The dominATE Experience when it came out, and the film debuted with nearly $20 million at the global box office. Fans say the Blu-ray film captures the same excitement of seeing it on the big screen, with one reviewer writing that, “The camera work does a great job of balancing full-stage shots with close-ups, so you don’t miss the choreography or the individual charisma of each member.”

The reviewer adds that “What stands out most is how immersive it feels—you can almost hear the fan chants and feel the atmosphere of the venue.”

OFFICIAL DVD RELEASE

Stray Kids: The dominATE Experience [DVD]

$11.77

You can also pick up an official copy of the Stray Kids concert film on DVD.

Just like the Blu-ray release, the DVD edition features the entire SoFi Stadium concert and backstage footage (though the bonus track is not included). Of course, the group members sang and interacted with the audience in both English and Korean; you can choose to turn subtitles on or off. This DVD has a runtime of two hours and 25 minutes.

You can also watch Stray Kids: The dominATE Experience online by renting or downloading it through Prime Video or stream it through Disney+ and Hulu .

GREAT FOR COLLECTORS

Stray Kids World Tour dominATE SEOUL (Blu-ray Version)

$59.99 $64.99 8% off

Fans can also pick up a Blu-ray copy of the Stray Kids Dominate World Tour show from their hometown of Seoul. That’s where the group kicked off their tour, back in August 2024.

This physical release includes the concert and behind-the-scenes footage spread across two Blu-ray discs, plus a bonus photo book, photo cards, photo stand and a fold-out poster. You also get eight Polaroid-style “ instant photo” prints of Bang Chan, Lee Know, Changbin, Hyunjin, Han, Felix, Seungmin and I.N, respectively. That makes this release a must-have for STAY and K-pop fans alike.

The Seoul concert is also available as an official DVD release with a black case here .

BEST FAN MERCH

Stray Kids THIS & THAT Album Photo Cards

$9.49

Want more from the K-pop superstars? Amazon’s top new merch release is this fan-made set of photocards inspired by the new album, THIS & THAT.

This set includes 60 photocards and 64 stickers of all the group members, album artwork and fan-inspired pics. The photocards measure approximately 3.5 x 2.5 x 0.75 inches in size.

OFFICIAL MERCH

Stray Kids – Official Light Stick Ver.2

$58.99

Buy Now AT WALMART

If you’re looking for officially-licensed merch, Walmart is selling this Stray Kids light stick set, which includes the lightstick a branded bracelet, a set of photocards, a lanyard and an instruction manual.

FOR FANS OF ALL AGES

Stray Kids: A Little Golden Book Biography

$6.51

Amazon, meantime, has this Stray Kids children’s book available to pre-order.

Part of the Little Golden Books Biography series for young readers, this picture book tracks the group’s rise to fame and impact on fans around the world. The book officially comes out in March but you can pre-order it now for just $6 on Amazon.com .

Stray Kids’ busy year continues into the fall. The group next heads to Japan and Colombia before playing Brazil. You can  find Stray Kids tickets here .
